name: Safe Area Layout
description: Responsive screen-space layout authority for game interfaces. Converts viewport bounds, device safe-area insets, and a spacing scale into named regions for HUD rails, center prompts, footer actions, and modal content. It owns geometry only: visual styling belongs to presentation.style_presets, navigation belongs to ui.interface_router, and no region receives gameplay authority.

inputs.name: viewport
inputs.description: Current CSS or logical viewport as {width, height}.

inputs.name: safeAreaInsets
inputs.description: Device insets in logical pixels. Interactive content stays inside these bounds.

outputs.name: computedRegions
outputs.description: Named rectangles as {id, x, y, width, height, anchor}; compact layouts collapse rails without moving modal content outside the safe area.

provenance: Added 2026-10-29 with the Adventure Interface Shell UI pack (84ece01). Provenance written after the fact on 2026-10-29: it landed recording only "library-native". Nearest in a catalogue search: ui.hud, which renders widgets; this owns screen regions and safe-area geometry only, with styling left to presentation.style_presets. Library-native.
